about_the_game:
SCP: Project 90 is a multiplayer action-horror game set in the SCP Foundation universe. Explore, fight, hide, survive. You’ll have to act in an unstable environment where every decision can be your last. You will find yourself at Site-102 - an experimental facility that has lost control. Play as guards, scientists, D-class personnel, insurgents, or even SCPs themselves. Each role has its own goals, abilities, and survival strategies. Features:

  • Site-102 - an original map with unique architecture, hidden areas, and its own backstory. Explore every corner - there may be more behind each door than it seems.,

  • Variety of SCPs - from classic anomalies to obscure and lesser-known entities.,

  • Multiplayer focused on tension and interaction - stay one step ahead, or fall to those who are stronger.,

  • Tactical weapons and interactive environments - use everything around you to survive or stop others.
